title: Rendlesham/Bentwaters cover-up and interrogations
place_text: RAF Bentwaters, Rendlesham Forest, Suffolk, UK

tellings.quote: No. OSI shows up in plane. HVT escort teams show up, haul everything away. People are sworn to secrecy.

plain: After a reported UFO sighting in 1980 at RAF Bentwaters, an air base beside Rendlesham Forest in Suffolk, England, investigators are said to have flown in, carted everything off and silenced the witnesses. Jake Barber, a guest, tells it second-hand, citing a British peer he calls Lord Norton: the Air Force Office of Special Investigations 'shows up in plane', escort teams for high-value cargo 'haul everything away', and 'people are sworn to secrecy', with interrogations to follow. If true, it would mean the event was covered up on purpose.
